description: Call 1-20 tools in one request with all arguments known in advance. Consecutive reads run in parallel (up to 4); writes run one at a time in input order and form barriers between read groups. The first observed error stops new calls; already-started reads finish. Returns every completed result, error and skipped call in input order. Validates all names/arguments before execution. Uses the same auth checks and secret filtering as individual tools. No nested batches, result references, retries or rollback. Inspect partial results before retrying writes.

id.description: Unique call ID, used to correlate results.

tool.description: An existing tool on this server; tools_batch cannot be nested.

name: tools_batch
title: Run a batch of StablecoinX tools
